scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:api-client && pnpm run check:boundaries && node scripts/ci/build-smoke.mjs --required
scripts.core:check: cd core && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p ohmydate-server --all-targets --features test-clock -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo test -p ohmydate-server --features test-clock
scripts.core:build: cd core && cargo build -p ohmydate-server --features test-clock
scripts.core:parity: pnpm run core:build && tsc --noEmit -p tests-core && vitest run --config tests-core/vitest.config.ts
scripts.core:shrink: cd core && cargo build -q -p ohmydate-scheduler --bin sched-diff && cd .. && tsc --noEmit -p packages/scheduler/scripts && pnpm --filter @ohmydate/contracts exec tsx ../scheduler/scripts/shrink-oracle.mts
scripts.core:harvest: mkdir -p core/target/oracle-corpus && rm -f core/target/oracle-corpus/reference-tests.jsonl && ORACLE_HARVEST_OUT=$PWD/core/target/oracle-corpus/reference-tests.jsonl SCHED_PROPERTY_RUNS=200 vitest run --config packages/scheduler/scripts/harvest.vitest.config.mts
scripts.core:diff: pnpm run core:harvest && pnpm run core:oracle --count ${ORACLE_COUNT:-2000} --seed ${ORACLE_SEED:-20261113} --name diff --out core/target/oracle --corpus core/target/oracle-corpus/reference-tests.jsonl && cd core && OHMYDATE_ORACLE_DIR=target/oracle cargo test -p ohmydate-scheduler --test oracle -- --nocapture
